rundown: Grizzlies beat Wizards 136-120 at Capital One Arena in Washington, DC in front of 16,307. Grizzlies came back: they were down 69-59 at the half. The 3rd quarter decided it: Grizzlies won it 42-18. Their win chance dropped as low as 15% along the way.
Leading the way — Grizzlies: Cameron Boozer 29 pts; Javon Small 12 ast; Zach Edey 10 reb. Wizards: Anthony Davis 23 pts; Trae Young 12 ast; Kyshawn George 6 reb.
Where Grizzlies won it: they shot 55% to 48%, shot 43% from three to 34% and won the boards 47-31.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Grizzlies closed as 3.5-point favorites and covered by 12.5; the total closed at 231.5 and they combined for 256, over by 24.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 16, 6:56 PM ET. It had Grizzlies 65% and Wizards 35%, projecting Grizzlies 121 – Wizards 116.5 (237.5 total, Grizzlies by 4.5).

Final: Grizzlies 136 – Wizards 120. Right winner: it had Grizzlies at 65%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Grizzlies came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (9-4, 120.6 scored and 111.7 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 81 and 80 games of evidence. Projected to score 121, they scored 136 (+15 points, 12% over); projected to allow 116.5, they allowed 120 (+3.5 points, 3% over).

Wizards came in with a 2% below average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (4-10, 110.6 scored and 118 allowed a game over 14 games), worth about 86 and 87 games of evidence. Projected to score 116.5, they scored 120 (+3.5 points, 3% over); projected to allow 121, they allowed 136 (+15 points, 12% over).

The bigger miss was Grizzlies' scoring (+15 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 256 against 237.5 projected (+18.5), about the 85th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Grizzlies by 16 against Grizzlies by 4.5 projected, about the 17th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Wizards ×1.02, Grizzlies ×1.00. It favored Wizards, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
WSH ML (+143) at +143: the algo gave it 39% vs 40% fair (-0.5 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 40%). MEM ML (-170) at -170: the algo gave it 61% vs 60% fair (+0.5 pts) — won (+0.6u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 60%). WSH +4.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (-0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing +3.5 by 1. MEM -4.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (+0.1 pts) — won (+1u); lost to the closing -3.5 by 1. OVER 231.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 52% vs 50% fair (+1.7 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 231.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 48% vs 50% fair (-1.7 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Wizards +4.5 → +3.5.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 59% of bets on Grizzlies, 53% of the money — Grizzlies covered; total: 78% of bets on the over, 86% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 80% of bets on Grizzlies, 62% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Wizards, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.074 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -10.8 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 91 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.997 and gives home teams +0.7 points. Team corrections so far: Grizzlies attack ×1.010, defense ×0.999 (7 games); Wizards attack ×1.006, defense ×1.040 (8 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
